framework_retired_public.consume_prior_tap_before: 1.22 removes the undo-button page StepHistory contract. Pure DokuActionRules.prior_tap and compatibility tests remain; production uses BoardGestureRecognizer and _business_history, not an equivalent call to the old page API.
framework_retired_public.complete_auto_mark_for_restore: 1.22 removes the old game_auto_mark experiment. Restore uses saved board/marks; auto_x/tool results commit fully before animation, so the old partial-animation repair helper is no longer needed. Retained schema fields do not reactivate the retired experiment.

streak_private_replacement._reset_broken_streak: 1.22 retains broken streak for ad revive; do_checkin/give_up/revive transitions in one candidate

contracts.legacy_diagnostics: GameState.on_level_won/failed remain callable (old parameters plus optional plan, bool success). _commit_legacy_progress stages selected plan and frozen ProgressState in one candidate, publishes after commit and deduplicates same plan/outcome. Removed unused live _apply_level_won/_apply_level_failed/_preserve_returnee_settlement/_dispatch_normal_level_settlement; complete pure implementations live in ProgressState. Fastjump prepares precat and Elo attempt on selection state. Simulator keeps plans, dirty and retry facts in that transaction, preserves retry puzzle ID, stops on failure and releases temporary overrides. It remains a dedup/probabilistic simulation, not an Elo performance simulation.
contracts.selection_effects: GameState.capture_selection_effect_context/publish_selection_effects bridge dispatches refresh_assist_user and invalid_recommendation only after successful selection commit; storage epoch/reset generation/current selection ID and pre-dispatch idempotency key guard reset/reentry/duplicate. ProductPort uses optional injected state methods and remains no-Autoload. Legacy diagnostic bridge dispatches through same guard. HasAssistUserTag uses actual usertag_ready(data), binds cache/request to storage epoch and drops old async replies. LevelRecManager head validation now injects a read-only runtime.
contracts.mouse_lifecycle: Mouse completion uses an owned timer and cancellation signal to synchronously unwind terminal parent await chains before page destruction; cancelled token and state clear precede emit. Input blocker removal also queues free; UI brief blocker timer is a child so destruction cannot orphan timer/weakref.
contracts.presentation_cache: Failed candidate rollback preserves only previously accepted start-toast display caches, while failed progression/runtime flags still restore authoritative state. Reset remains able to clear all caches.
contracts.schema: 2; exact 211 source profile fields projected into profile/inventory/endgame; unknown profile fields preserved. Explicit schema1→2 and scattered legacy imports only. Future schema refuses fallback.
contracts.readback: ConfigFile parse required plus decrypted original text byte equality; no numeric tolerance. Fractional timer parser/re-encoder ULP drift no longer produces false write rejection.
contracts.settlement: Next special-level DDA check receives the same frozen runtime (no implicit builtin-table fallback). identity validation then frozen-policy pure ProgressState then today/streak/rank+robots/companion/profile-costume/time/attempt stats/presentation receipt in same candidate; publish only after single commit; duplicates return stored presentation.
contracts.tools: accepted use increments original1.22 daily/DDA facts; only paid hint/locate/legacyundo sets has_used_tool; draft/mouse excluded per1.22. Statistics cache synchronizes only after accepted action; entry resets solution-step cache from committed state.
contracts.awards: AwardPage close/error callbacks also bind reward revision+uid+show_id; entry gates and gift-cell animation/timers are explicitly cancellable. mixed tool/frame assets and eligibility/pending removal in one candidate; stable claim keys; category TOOL only doubles; overflow invalid oldbalances refuses before consuming; showID and page generation guard callbacks.
contracts.cloud: explicit force survives version conflict; account generation rejects stale responses; original core/profile/rank/streak sync + remote baseline in single local commit; failure leaves pending choice; logging redacts game_data payload.
contracts.peekaboo: claim_reward(amount,expected_day,event_id) commits rank/robots+dated entitlement+receipt; duplicate no write; failed claims retain retry intent; parent owns UI exact-ID/cancellation.
contracts.streak: worker pure candidate stages original history/revive rules; same-day duplicate no write; failed write does not publish reward; reentrant newer state wins; 1.22 broken history preserved by watch.
contracts.session: capture elapsed interval before commit; preserve pending seconds after failure; observed in-flight time exactly once; reset generation guards nested signals; debug new session flushes old interval.
contracts.reset: full player defaults incl rule collapse + gamble user, epoch/sequence retained to invalidate old callbacks; failure preserves live runtime flags; no feature-file partial deletes.
contracts.legacy_color_migration: obsolete cc_deferred_used/cc_disabled/cc_defer_until normalization moved out of normal snapshot hydration into explicit legacy/schema migration.
contracts.presentation_wait_cancellation: UIBaseWindow owns cancellable signal/predicate waits by presentation revision. Reopen/refresh/destruction invalidates old ownership before synchronous cancellation, allowing the on_hide→_do_hide parent chain to unwind. Fourteen real product close flows use these helpers; Daily parent separately checks child revision/weakref and resumes active gameplay clock on child cancellation without accepting a new presentation completion. Test fixture uses same helpers; original74checks preserved plus83real checks, strict157/0.
